sbe:messageSchema.description: GCM-MD normalized internal market data messages (v4: common header, numeric instrument key, batch envelope)

composite.name: gcmHeader
composite.description: GCM common message header — 48 bytes, frozen layout. sequenceId abs offset 8, sequenceTimestamp abs offset 32, eventId abs offset 40.

type.name: sequenceId
type.description: Globally monotonic sequence ID assigned by the GCM-MD sequencer. Monotonic and sequential across ALL instruments and sources; gaps permitted (block-lease recovery, failover). Written by sequencer at absolute offset 8. Line handlers write 0.

type.name: sourceTimestamp
type.description: Source-originated timestamp, nanos since Unix epoch. CME: TransactTime. Written by line handler.

type.name: ingestTimestamp
type.description: Line handler ingest timestamp, nanos since Unix epoch. Written by line handler.

type.name: sequenceTimestamp
type.description: Sequencer assignment timestamp, nanos since Unix epoch (Agrona OffsetEpochNanoClock). Written by sequencer at absolute offset 32. Line handlers write 0.

type.name: eventId
type.description: Source-scoped matching-engine event ID assigned by the line handler; identical across all messages of one event including the MatchEventBoundary. 0 = not part of a tracked event. At absolute offset 40 so the sequencer can read it with one fixed-offset load.

type.name: reserved1
type.description: Reserved for future sequencer-stamped metadata (e.g. partition/epoch id for sharded sequencers). Producers MUST zero-fill; consumers MUST ignore.

composite.name: varBlobEncoding
composite.description: Variable-length binary blob (one complete SBE message incl. its messageHeader)

type.name: PriceOptional
type.description: Optional price as IEEE 754 double. NaN = field not present (delta).

type.name: Price
type.description: Required price as IEEE 754 double.

type.name: DecimalOptional
type.description: Optional decimal as IEEE 754 double. NaN = not present.

type.name: Decimal
type.description: Required decimal as IEEE 754 double.

type.name: QtyNULL
type.description: Optional quantity. Null = not present in delta.

type.name: Int32NULL
type.description: Optional int32. Null = not present.

type.name: UInt8NULL
type.description: Optional uint8. Null = not present.

type.name: UInt16NULL
type.description: Optional uint16. Null = not present.

type.name: UInt64NULL
type.description: Optional uint64. Null = not present.

type.name: InstrumentId
type.description: GCM-MD compact numeric instrument key. Resolve via InstrumentDefinition.

type.name: Symbol
type.description: GCM-MD normalized symbol (e.g. NGQ2026). Year expanded to 4 digits.

type.name: SourceSymbol
type.description: Exact symbol as received from source (e.g. CME sends NGQ6). Verbatim, no transformation.

type.name: Source
type.description: Data source (e.g. CME, ICE, BBG) or internal component (SEQR)

type.name: Exchange
type.description: Exchange code (e.g. NYMX, XCME)

type.name: Currency
type.description: ISO 4217 currency code

type.name: Asset
type.description: Asset/product code (e.g. NG)

type.name: SecurityGroup
type.description: Security group (e.g. NG)

type.name: UnitOfMeasure
type.description: Unit of measure (e.g. MMBtu)

composite.name: MaturityMonthYear
composite.description: Contract maturity: year, month, optional day/week

enum.name: UpdateType
enum.description: Identifies whether this message is a full snapshot or an incremental delta update

validValue.name: SNAPSHOT
validValue.description: Full instrument state — all fields populated

validValue.name: DELTA
validValue.description: Incremental update — only changed fields populated, others null

enum.name: AssetClass
enum.description: Broad asset class for NATS subject routing

enum.name: TradingStatus
enum.description: Current trading state of the instrument

validValue.name: DELETE_THRU
validValue.description: Delete this level and all better

validValue.name: DELETE_FROM
validValue.description: Delete this level and all worse

validValue.name: SEQUENCER
validValue.description: Sequencer liveness + high-water mark for gap detection in quiet markets

set.name: FieldPresence
set.description: Bitmask indicating which optional fields are present in this message

choice.name: bidNumOrders
choice.description: Bid number of orders is present

choice.name: askNumOrders
choice.description: Ask number of orders is present

sbe:message.name: MarketDataTick
sbe:message.description: Normalized market data snapshot (or simple-handler delta) for a single instrument — fully self-describing

field.name: askPrice
field.description: Best ask/offer price. CME: MDEntryType 1 (Offer).

field.name: lastTradePrice
field.description: Last trade price. CME: MDEntryType 2 (Trade) from MDIncrementalRefreshTradeSummary.

field.name: settlementPrice

field.name: openPrice
field.description: Session opening price. CME: MDEntryType 4 (OpenPrice) from MDIncrementalRefreshSessionStatistics.

field.name: highPrice

field.name: lowPrice

field.name: impliedBidPrice
field.description: Implied bid price. CME: MDEntryType E (ImpliedBid).

field.name: impliedAskPrice

field.name: vwapPrice

field.name: highLimitPrice

field.name: lowLimitPrice

field.name: maxPriceVariation

field.name: minPriceIncrement

field.name: displayFactor

field.name: contractSize

field.name: bidSize
field.description: Aggregate size at best bid. CME: MDEntrySize where MDEntryType=Bid.

field.name: askSize
field.description: Aggregate size at best ask. CME: MDEntrySize where MDEntryType=Offer.

field.name: lastTradeQty
field.description: Last trade quantity. CME: MDEntrySize from MDIncrementalRefreshTradeSummary.

field.name: totalVolume
field.description: Total cleared volume for the session. CME: MDEntryType B (ClearedVolume).

field.name: electronicVolume
field.description: Cumulative electronic traded volume. CME: MDEntryType e (ElectronicVolume).

field.name: openInterest
field.description: Open interest. CME: MDEntryType C (OpenInterest).

field.name: fieldPresence
field.description: Bitmask indicating which optional fields carry data in this message

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Source-specific per-instrument sequence number (e.g. CME RptSeq)

field.name: instrumentId

field.name: sourceSecurityId

field.name: bidNumOrders
field.description: Aggregate number of orders at best bid. CME: NumberOfOrders from Book (Bid).

field.name: askNumOrders
field.description: Aggregate number of orders at best ask. CME: NumberOfOrders from Book (Offer).

field.name: expiryDate
field.description: Last trading date as YYYYMMDD. Derived from CME EventType=LastEligibleTradeDate.

field.name: maturityMonthYear
field.description: Contract maturity. CME: tag 200.

field.name: updateType
field.description: SNAPSHOT (full state) or DELTA (only changed fields)

field.name: assetClass
field.description: Broad asset class for routing

field.name: instrumentType
field.description: Future, option, spread, or spot

field.name: tradingStatus
field.description: Current trading state. CME: mapped from SecurityTradingStatus.

field.name: settlementType
field.description: Settlement price type. CME: mapped from SettlPriceType bitfield.

field.name: symbol
field.description: GCM-MD normalized symbol. CME: derived from tag 55 with year expanded (NGQ6 → NGQ2026).

field.name: sourceSymbol
field.description: Exact symbol as received from data source. CME: tag 55 Symbol verbatim (e.g. NGQ6).

field.name: source
field.description: Data source (CME, ICE, BBG, etc.)

field.name: exchange
field.description: Exchange code (NYMX, XCME, etc.). CME: tag 207.

field.name: asset
field.description: Product code. CME: tag 6937 Asset.

field.name: securityGroup
field.description: Security group. CME: tag 1151 SecurityGroup.

field.name: currency
field.description: Price currency (USD, EUR, etc.). CME: tag 15.

field.name: unitOfMeasure
field.description: Unit of measure for contract size. CME: tag 996 (e.g. MMBtu for NG).

sbe:message.name: TradeSummary
sbe:message.description: Trade execution detail for a single instrument — compact, identity via instrumentId

field.name: header
field.description: GCM common header

field.name: tradePrice
field.description: Trade price. CME: MDEntryPx from TradeSummary.

field.name: tradeQty
field.description: Consolidated trade quantity. CME: MDEntrySize from TradeSummary.

field.name: sourceTradeId
field.description: Source-specific trade ID. CME: MDTradeEntryID.

field.name: instrumentId
field.description: v4: compact instrument key. Resolve via InstrumentDefinition.

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Source per-instrument seq num. CME: RptSeq.

field.name: numberOfOrders
field.description: Number of orders participating in the match. CME: NumberOfOrders.

field.name: aggressorSide
field.description: Aggressor side. CME: AggressorSide.

sbe:message.name: Heartbeat
sbe:message.description: Liveness signal — line handler feed liveness or sequencer high-water-mark heartbeat

field.name: header
field.description: GCM common header. For SEQUENCER heartbeats, sequenceId/sequenceTimestamp are stamped normally.

field.name: highWaterSequenceId
field.description: v4: current high-water (last assigned) sequenceId. Populated on SEQUENCER heartbeats; null on line handler heartbeats. Consumers use this for quiet-market gap detection.

field.name: messageCount
field.description: Cumulative message count since component start

field.name: instrumentCount
field.description: Number of active instruments (line handler heartbeats; 0 for sequencer)

field.name: heartbeatType
field.description: v4: LINE_HANDLER or SEQUENCER

field.name: source
field.description: Emitting component identifier (e.g. CME, SEQR)

sbe:message.name: BookUpdate
sbe:message.description: Multi-level aggregate order book update (MBP) — depth levels 1-10 per side, identity via instrumentId

field.name: header
field.description: GCM common header

field.name: instrumentId
field.description: v4: compact instrument key. Resolve via InstrumentDefinition.

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Source per-instrument seq num. CME: RptSeq.

field.name: updateType
field.description: SNAPSHOT (full book) or DELTA (incremental level updates)

field.name: price
field.description: Price at this book level. CME: MDEntryPx.

field.name: size
field.description: Aggregate quantity at this level. CME: MDEntrySize.

field.name: numberOfOrders
field.description: Number of orders at this level. CME: NumberOfOrders.

field.name: tradeableSize
field.description: Tradeable qty at this level. CME: TradeableSize.

field.name: priceLevel
field.description: Book level: 1=best ... 10=deepest. CME: MDPriceLevel.

field.name: side
field.description: Side. CME: MDEntryTypeBook.

field.name: action
field.description: Update action. CME: MDUpdateAction.

sbe:message.name: MatchEventBoundary
sbe:message.description: End-of-event marker for atomic event processing. eventId in gcmHeader links all messages of the event.

field.name: header
field.description: GCM common header. eventId (abs 40) identifies this event; identical across all messages of the event.

field.name: firstSequenceId
field.description: ABSOLUTE OFFSET 56. Global sequenceId of the first message of this event. Stamped by the SEQUENCER (optional feature); line handler writes 0.

field.name: lastSequenceId
field.description: ABSOLUTE OFFSET 64. Global sequenceId of the last message of this event (excluding this boundary). Stamped by the SEQUENCER (optional feature); line handler writes 0.

field.name: messageCount
field.description: Number of data messages in this event (excluding this boundary). Line-handler written; consumers verify buffered count against this to detect torn events.

field.name: eventFlags
field.description: Event content flags: bit0=trades, bit1=volume, bit2=quotes, bit3=statistics, bit4=implied, bit5=recovery. CME: MatchEventIndicator bits.

field.name: source
field.description: Data source

sbe:message.name: OrderUpdate
sbe:message.description: Individual order update (MBO) — single order new/change/delete, identity via instrumentId

field.name: header
field.description: GCM common header

field.name: orderId
field.description: Unique order identifier assigned by the exchange. CME: OrderID.

field.name: orderPriority
field.description: Order priority for execution on the book. CME: MDOrderPriority.

field.name: price
field.description: Order price. CME: MDEntryPx.

field.name: instrumentId
field.description: v4: compact instrument key. Resolve via InstrumentDefinition.

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Source per-instrument seq num. CME: RptSeq.

field.name: displayQty
field.description: Visible order quantity. CME: MDDisplayQty.

field.name: side
field.description: Side. CME: MDEntryTypeBook.

field.name: action
field.description: Order action. CME: OrderUpdateAction.

field.name: updateType
field.description: SNAPSHOT (full order book) or DELTA (individual order update)

sbe:message.name: TradeFill
sbe:message.description: Per-order fill details from a trade event — which orders were matched and for how much, identity via instrumentId

field.name: header
field.description: GCM common header. eventId links fills to the trade's matching event.

field.name: tradePrice
field.description: Trade price (same as parent TradeSummary). For consumer convenience.

field.name: sourceTradeId
field.description: Source trade entry ID linking to TradeSummary. CME: MDTradeEntryID.

field.name: instrumentId
field.description: v4: compact instrument key. Resolve via InstrumentDefinition.

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Source per-instrument seq num. CME: RptSeq.

group.name: fills
group.description: Individual order fills in this trade

field.name: orderId
field.description: Order ID that was filled. CME: OrderID from NoOrderIDEntries.

field.name: fillQty
field.description: Quantity filled for this order. CME: LastQty.

sbe:message.name: MarketDataDelta
sbe:message.description: Compact incremental update — only changed fields, identity via instrumentId. Primary steady-state message.

field.name: header
field.description: GCM common header. sequenceId abs 8, sequenceTimestamp abs 32 — structurally identical to every other message.

field.name: fieldPresence
field.description: Bitmask of which fields are in changedFields group

field.name: instrumentId
field.description: v4: compact instrument key. Resolve via InstrumentDefinition.

field.name: sourceSeqNum
field.description: Source per-instrument sequence number

field.name: assetClass
field.description: Broad asset class — retained for cheap consumer-side routing without registry lookup

group.name: changedFields
group.description: Changed field values — only modified fields

field.name: value
field.description: Field value as int64. Price fields (bits 0-9,16-18): Double.doubleToRawLongBits(double). Qty fields (10-15): raw long. Enum/status (19-22): ordinal widened to long.

field.name: fieldId
field.description: Field ID — maps to FieldPresence bit position

sbe:message.name: MessageBatch
sbe:message.description: Sequencer egress batch envelope — N stamped SBE messages in one publish

field.name: firstSequenceId
field.description: sequenceId of the first packed message — batch-level gap detection without unpacking

field.name: lastSequenceId
field.description: sequenceId of the last packed message

field.name: batchTimestamp
field.description: Sequencer flush timestamp (nanos since epoch)

field.name: flags
field.description: bit0 = batch ends on a MatchEventBoundary (event-aligned flush); bits 1-7 reserved

data.name: messageBlob
data.description: One complete SBE message including its 8-byte messageHeader
